article_title: Your partner's snoring could be impacting your health

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central message?
options: Snoring affects only the person who snores
A partner's snoring can disrupt sleep, health and relationships, and help is available
Most sleep problems are caused by dreaming
Couples should always sleep in separate rooms
tasks.correct_answer: A partner's snoring can disrupt sleep, health and relationships, and help is available
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שנחירות של בן או בת זוג עלולות לפגוע בשינה, בתפקוד וברווחה, ומציגה דרכי אבחון וטיפול.

tasks.prompt: According to the BSSAA, about what proportion of UK adults snore?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי האגודה הבריטית לנחירות ודום נשימה בשינה, כ־40% מהמבוגרים בבריטניה נוחרים.

tasks.prompt: What does “fragmented sleep” mean in the article?
options: Sleep that lasts longer than usual
Sleep during which a person never dreams
Sleep taken only in the daytime
Sleep repeatedly interrupted by waking
tasks.explanation_hebrew: fragmented sleep היא שינה מקוטעת — שינה שנקטעת שוב ושוב, למשל בגלל נחירות של בן זוג.

tasks.prompt: Which combination is identified as possible signs of sleep apnoea?
options: Pauses in breathing, choking, frequent waking and morning headaches
Only talking and moving during dreams
Feeling hungry before bed and waking early
Snoring softly while breathing remains steady
tasks.correct_answer: Pauses in breathing, choking, frequent waking and morning headaches
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מונה הפסקות נשימה, חנק בלילה, יקיצות תכופות וכאבי ראש בבוקר כסימנים אפשריים לדום נשימה בשינה.

tasks.prompt: Why does Dr Clare Simon warn against simply making a snorer quieter?
options: Quiet treatments always damage hearing
The noise helps partners enter deeper sleep
It could hide an underlying sleep-related breathing disorder
Doctors cannot assess anyone who uses ear plugs
tasks.correct_answer: It could hide an underlying sleep-related breathing disorder
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המטרה אינה רק להפחית רעש; טיפול כזה עלול להסתיר הפרעת נשימה בשינה, כגון דום נשימה, שדורשת אבחון.

tasks.prompt: What does “restorative stages” mean in the discussion of sleep?
options: Stages in which people are most likely to snore
Deeper stages that help the body recover
Periods when a person is fully awake
Moments used mainly to plan the next day
tasks.correct_answer: Deeper stages that help the body recover
tasks.explanation_hebrew: restorative stages הם שלבי השינה העמוקים החשובים להתאוששות הגופנית.

tasks.prompt: Explain how disrupted sleep can affect the partner of a snorer during the following day.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין כמה השפעות קוגניטיביות, גופניות ורגשיות המתוארות בכתבה.
expected_points: Less time may be spent in deep restorative sleep
The person may wake feeling tired or groggy
Processing and storing information may be interrupted
Focus and memory may worsen
Hormone regulation may affect energy and motivation
Stress regulation may become less balanced
The person may feel more irritable and less able to cope

tasks.prompt: Why can snoring become a relationship problem rather than just a noise problem?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד שינה מקוטעת משפיעה על מצב הרוח, ויכוחים, אינטימיות וסידורי השינה.
expected_points: Broken sleep can increase irritability
Tired partners may argue more
Repeated prodding or attempts to change position can create tension
One partner may move to a separate room
Separate sleeping may reduce intimacy
The problem can affect both partners' wellbeing

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's explanation of the risks, warning signs and possible responses to snoring.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את השפעות הנחירות, ההבדל מדום נשימה ואת דרכי הפעולה המוצעות.
expected_points: A partner's snoring can fragment sleep
Poor sleep can affect memory, focus, energy, stress and mood
Relationships may also be affected
Sleep apnoea warning signs should not be ignored
A GP or specialist can advise
CPAP or surgery may be used for sleep apnoea
Lifestyle changes may help simple snoring
Nasal treatment or a custom mouthguard may be recommended

tasks.prompt: Write a tactful message encouraging a snoring partner to seek help while avoiding blame.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית מסר אמפתי שמציג את ההשפעה, מזכיר סימני אזהרה ומציע צעדים מעשיים ללא האשמה.
expected_points: Use a respectful and non-accusatory tone
Describe the effect on shared sleep or wellbeing
Suggest checking for breathing pauses, choking or morning headaches
Recommend speaking to a GP if warning signs appear
Mention one lifestyle change that may help simple snoring
Acknowledge that effective help is available
